fields.summary: Autonomous plan run, no owner present, so no owner words are quoted. The change set's intent: rhiza run findings numbers each finding f1, f2, ... from a count read in the run, so two concurrent calls in one session can journal the same ID. Planned outcome: findings are numbered under the run's lock, for the round, --check and leaf findings alike. Decisions below are the planner's assumptions, not owner decisions; the owner has not confirmed them.
fields.title: Findings numbering under the run's lock

fields.acceptance: A testscript runs concurrent findings calls for one round, one --check and one leaf, then asserts that the findings journalled within each of those scopes have unique IDs
fields.statement: Concurrent findings calls within one round, check or leaf never journal two findings with the same ID
